messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened PR to migrate hello-minima quickstart to SDK v8 — fixes auth snippets and Dockerfile. Need eyeballs for link updates and ephemeral token note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
ken: Nice, thanks — can you add a note about KMS env var? Dockerfile doesn't reference KMS_KEY.
eva: I'll run through the quickstart and test the docker build. ETA today.
sam: Assign me as reviewer, I can check snippets and run the examples. Any migration gotchas?
maria: Main gotcha: SDK client init changed from `new Client()` to `Client.fromEnv()` — added example:
```js
// old
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
// new (recommended)
const c = Client.fromEnv()
``` 
ken: Can we keep both examples? Older users might copy-paste. Suggest showing both and marking "recommended".
maria: good point, added both variants and prefaced with migration note. Also pinging @docs-bot to run linkchecker.
docs-bot: Link check queued: 12 files scanned, 1 failure (assets/hello.png) — https://linkcheck/reports/987
eva: I found the image at /static/images/hello.png. I'll open a tiny PR to fix paths or move asset.
sam: If image moves, update CDN path too. Also add note about ephemeral tokens for local dev: `rw login --dev` and example of env export.
maria: Added short 'local dev' paragraph + command. PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — PTAL @ken @eva @sam
ken: :thumbsup: will review after lunch.
eva: Checking build now — leaving inline comments in the PR.
maria: thanks all. If no blockers by EOD I'll merge and trigger docs deploy :shipit:
